title: Apple MagSafe Wireless Charger (1st Gen)

comparisons.notes: Model MHXH3AM/A (UPC 194252192375), new, 1m USB-C cable, 15W. On clearance, limited quantities, in stock with free shipping.

writeup: Woot has Apple's first-generation MagSafe Charger (model MHXH3AM/A), brand new, for $14.99. It snaps magnetically onto iPhone 12 and later and charges at up to 15W over a built-in 1m USB-C cable. P.C. Richard & Son has the same charger on clearance for $29, so this is about half off. Woot showed only one left, limit three per customer.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN from the Woot offer data, confirmed as the same Apple MagSafe Charger MHXH3AM/A by the price checker
